div.style: color: rgb(53, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
consumers
PK id : uuid · UQ name : text
name: lowercase a-z / 0-9 / hyphen, 1–80 chars
state: pending | active | suspended | revoked
created_at, updated_at : timestamptz
Trigger: ID/name immutable; deletion rejected

div.style: color: rgb(53, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
members · owners and members share one table
PK (consumer_id, github_user_id)
FK consumer_id : uuid
github_user_id : bigint, greater than 0
role: owner | member
Deferred trigger: at least one owner per consumer
Membership cannot move between consumers

div.style: color: rgb(53, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
environments
PK (consumer_id, environment) · FK consumer_id
environment : text, a-z / 0-9 / hyphen, 1–40 chars
state: pending | active | suspended | revoked
allowed_source_keys : text[] = empty array
Array elements cannot be NULL; no source FK

div.style: color: rgb(53, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
lifecycle_audit
PK id : uuid · FK consumer_id : uuid
actor_github_user_id : bigint, greater than 0
action: created | member_added | member_removed
occurred_at : timestamptz
Actor ID has no membership FK

div.style: color: rgb(53, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
usage_daily · RESERVED, not collected by R1
PK (consumer_id, environment, day, outcome)
FK (consumer_id, environment)
day : date
outcome: success | client_error | server_error
request_count : bigint = 0, at least 0

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 47) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
R1 boundary: PUBLIC privileges revoked
No serving / corpus-reader / report grants added
No credentials table, HTTP wiring, or usage writer

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: EXISTING · public · acquisition and maintenance (no FKs)

div.style: color: rgb(18, 40, 62) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
raw_documents
PK id : uuid
source_key, url, canonical_url, raw_content : text
fetched_at : timestamptz · ingested_at? : timestamptz
index_attempted_at? · index_attempted_model?
Latest index: source_key, canonical_url,
fetched_at DESC, id DESC

div.style: color: rgb(18, 40, 62) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
language_change_audits
PK id : uuid
run_id, source_key : text · document_id : uuid
old_language?, new_language?, detector_model? : text
UQ (run_id, document_id) · no document FK

div.style: color: rgb(18, 40, 62) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
http_cache
PK url : text
etag?, last_modified?, body_hash? : text
status_code? : int
fetched_at, updated_at : timestamptz

div.style: color: rgb(18, 40, 62) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
robots_cache
PK robots_url : text
body? : text · status_code? : int
fetched_at, updated_at : timestamptz

div.style: color: rgb(18, 40, 62) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
sources
PK id : uuid
UQ key : text
name : text · languages/default_tags : jsonb
domain?, trust?, ingestion_mode?, rights? : text

div.style: color: rgb(18, 40, 62) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
documents
PK id : uuid · FK source_id : uuid
canonical_url, content_hash : text
title?, language?, category? : text
chunk_count : int = 0
UQ (source_id, canonical_url)

div.style: color: rgb(18, 40, 62) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
chunks
PK id : uuid
FK document_id, source_id : uuid
ord, char_start, char_end, token_count : int
text : text · tags : jsonb
search_tsv : generated tsvector
GIN (tags), GIN (search_tsv)

div.style: color: rgb(18, 40, 62) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
chunk_embeddings
PK / FK chunk_id : uuid
embedding : halfvec(1536)
embedding_model : text
HNSW cosine index on embedding

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 47) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
FORGE RAG DATABASE · corpus + R1 consumer registry
Blue: existing public tables · Amber: NEW in draft PR #2397
PK primary key · UQ unique · FK foreign key · ? nullable
Solid arrows: parent → child FK (1 → 0..many unless labeled)
Logical references listed separately; not enforced

div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 47) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
LOGICAL REFERENCES · NO FOREIGN KEYS
raw_documents.source_key → sources.key
language_change_audits.document_id → documents.id
language_change_audits.source_key → sources.key
environments.allowed_source_keys → sources.key values
